## About
German Imports Corporation repairs fine European and Asian automobiles out of our shop on Walsingham Road in Largo. We're an authorized Bosch Service provider, and we also handle wholesale and retail parts and full detail service.
Neighbors bring us their BMWs, Audis, Porsches and a Tiguan, and one family brought in a Camry they were worried about. It turned out to be just the battery. We'd rather check everything and tell you straight than hand you a big bill you don't need.
Our customers rate us 4.9 on Google from 617 reviews. Call us and we'll talk through what your car needs.

## Services
- Expert Maintenance and Mechanical Service: Maintenance and mechanical repair for fine European and Asian automobiles.
- Diagnostics: One Porsche owner came in for a diagnostic. It was a cooling sensor, and after clearing it all was good.
- Wholesale and Retail Parts: Parts available whether you're a shop or doing the work yourself.
- Full Detail Service: Have your car detailed while it's with us.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We repair fine European and Asian automobiles. Reviewers have brought in BMWs, Audis, a Porsche, a Tiguan and a Camry.

Q: Do you offer a ride while my car is in the shop?
A: Yes. We have a courtesy shuttle within 3 miles of the shop.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday from 7:30 AM to 6:00 PM, and Wednesday from 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Please call ahead about weekends.
